slides.title: 60 pages to a 1-page board brief in 5 Claude steps
slides.sub: Five steps. Decisions first. Every point checkable.

slides.title: Upload it, then set the reader
slides.body: “Board members with five minutes and no technical background” is a different brief from “the CFO”.

slides.title: Ask for decisions first
slides.body: Decided. Needs a decision. Risks. Next steps.

slides.title: Demand page references
slides.body: A page number behind every key point.
slides.tip: A summary you can check beats one you have to trust.

slides.title: Ask what's missing
slides.body: “What would a sceptical board member ask that this document doesn't answer?”

slides.title: Edit and verify
slides.body: Check every figure and reference against the source. Cut anything that sounds like marketing.

slides.title: One rule
slides.body: Only upload documents your data policy allows in the tool you use. Confidential board material belongs in an approved enterprise setup.

slides.title: Get the 6 prompts
slides.body: Free. The link is in the post.
